title: order.cancelled, version 2
description: The order was cancelled; data.reason says why when the cancel had a reason (MERCHANT_TIMEOUT, PAYMENT_TIMEOUT, MERCHANT_REJECTED: <note>). Dispatch cancels an open delivery from it. Topic order-events, record key: the order id, aggregate: ORDER (aggregate_id = the order id). Version 2 adds the optional data.order_no, the order's public number.
